subject.title: [Feature]: Chat welcome screen: animated Clawd hero, drop status badge, list recent user chats instead of canned suggestions

question: Should the animated lobster and recent-session list become the default empty-chat welcome experience, and which session categories and ranking rules should that list use?
rationale: The codebase supplies the necessary component and navigation seams, but no existing contract determines this prominent visual direction or the precise definition of a recent resumable user chat.

options.title: Approve focused full redesign
options.body: Define a bounded recent-session policy and implement the mascot, badge removal, recent rows, and canned-prompt fallback together.

options.title: Split visual and navigation work
options.body: Approve the mascot and layout changes now while deciding recent-session eligibility and ranking in a separate focused issue.

options.title: Retain the current welcome
options.body: Keep the existing avatar, readiness badge, and canned suggestions as the default empty-chat experience.

recommendation.title: Approve focused full redesign
recommendation.body: Define a bounded recent-session policy and implement the mascot, badge removal, recent rows, and canned-prompt fallback together.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the adjacent merged mascot direction, recently changed the same welcome/session surface, and authored this requested product direction.
